meta.notes: NOT YET POPULATED. Feature 5 (click-a-word synonyms) is out of first-session scope. Derive from WordNet filtered to roughly the top 20-30k lemmas across verbs, adjectives and common nouns. Format is {"led": ["directed", "guided"]}. Ship as a lazily loaded chunk so it does not bloat first paint, and never call a thesaurus API -- that would break the no-network constraint.
